title: Recorded native probe - no evaluated-model decisions

provenance.origin: Real recorded Dwarf Fortress game measurements, exported for offline inspection.
provenance.measurement_preservation: The status, before, advance, and after objects retain the parsed source values. JSON formatting is curated.
provenance.event_preservation: Original probe event numbers, timestamps, requests, and native results are retained. Installation/bootstrap events and local machine paths/session identifiers are omitted.
limitations: This is a completed native-game connectivity and tick-advance probe, not a completed model benchmark episode.
No evaluated-model decisions, game screenshots, or game video are included.
The observations do not establish improved wellbeing or completed brewing.
Serving this recording does not launch or contact Dwarf Fortress, DFHack, or any model service.

measurement_notes.citizens: Living fortress citizens, including insane citizens, using isCitizen(unit, true).
measurement_notes.former_citizens: Previously observed citizens; a missing unit is not automatically a death. History before this session is not reconstructed.
measurement_notes.needs: Native need_level and focus_level; no inferred wellbeing score.
measurement_notes.timers: Raw native counters; no clinical or welfare thresholds applied.
measurement_notes.wounds: Native wound record count, not a count or severity estimate of lasting injuries.

definitions.candidate: Excludes listed item flags; does not verify container flags, ownership of map, path access, ingredient suitability, or reservations
definitions.drink: DRINK item type only; excludes food and containers
definitions.prepared_food: FOOD item type only; prepared meals, not all edible items
definitions.source: world.items.other.IN_PLAY; one record per native item object
definitions.units: sum of getStackSize(); item_objects counts stacks, not portions
